title: What Scripture Actually Says About Rest (It's Not Laziness)
caption:
Rest feels like a sin to a man who was raised on work. Scripture doesn't read it that way.

God rested first, and He wasn't tired. The Sabbath was made for you. And laziness is a different animal entirely.

What would one real day off look like for you?
